lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 high-contrast vertical lines. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-torso, becoming slightly more compressed and thinner toward the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Topological bifurcations observed in lines 3 and 4 (counting from posterior) in the upper-mid quadrant of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most posterior line segment terminates prematurely above the lower belly line. The two most anterior lines near the shoulder are abbreviated, not reaching the dorsal or ventral boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots located on the lower posterior haunch, arranged in a triangular cluster.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align to form a semi-horizontal geometric orientation.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white chevron-like markings present on the bridge of the snout between the eyes and two white spots visible on the lower cheek/mandible area. Large white patch visible on the ventral-anterior neck.
